# costgraph_virtual_tags (Data Source)

List virtual tag key metadata in one authorized tenant. Requires virtual-tags:read. Reads all pages and sorts keys by key then UUID. This does not retrieve or modify rules. Use costgraph_virtual_tag for one complete configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "tenant_id" {
  type = string
}

data "costgraph_virtual_tags" "available" {
  tenant_id = var.tenant_id
}

output "virtual_tag_keys" {
  value = data.costgraph_virtual_tags.available.keys
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tenant_id` (String) Tenant UUID authorized by the API key.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable tenant-bound collection identifier.
- `keys` (Attributes List) Key metadata sorted by key then UUID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--keys))

<a id="nestedatt--keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `keys`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Key description.
- `id` (String) Key UUID.
- `key` (String) Virtual tag key.
- `revision` (String) Aggregate metadata and rules revision.
- `rule_count` (Number) Number of rules, including paused rules.
- `rules_revision` (Number) Server rules revision.
